notes: A track that opens on music is timed from where the voice actually enters now. The anchor used to be the first strong rise in the track, and a drum or a crash rises harder than a voice does, so the first lines still lit up during the opening.
Singing is a stream of rises rather than a single hit, so the entrance is the first place they come thick and fast and keep coming, counted across a three second window.
A beat every half second cannot reach the count a voice at four syllables a second does, which is what separates the opening bars from the first line.
The first line is still snapped onto that entrance like every other line, and the forward search that finds it is unchanged.
The word-by-word and letter-by-letter highlight are untouched, and the letter fade the last build set is exactly as it was.
The widget and the player are untouched: a press on the home-screen widget still resumes the song without opening the app.
